name: Marketing Router
description: Routes inbound conversational messages through mpaios marketing templates (sequences, churn win-back, surveys) and steers outbound replies via openclaw's prompt pipeline.

enabled.label: Marketing Router
enabled.help: Enable or pause the marketing router while keeping commands available.

agents.label: Target Agents
agents.help: Agent ids that receive marketing routing. Empty means all.

defaultSequenceId.label: Default Sequence
defaultSequenceId.help: Sequence id used for new conversations. Defaults to 'welcome'.

allowedChatTypes.label: Allowed Chat Types
allowedChatTypes.help: Chat types eligible for routing. Defaults to direct.

surveyTrigger.label: Survey Trigger
surveyTrigger.help: Which survey flow to attach after support sessions close.

logging.label: Enable Logging
logging.help: Emit router decisions to the gateway log.
